Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner abruptly changed the conclusion to option C (surface temperature), conflating core temperature (which enables fusion) with surface temperature and introducing an “observable” criterion not asked for in the prompt. This contradicted the prior evidence gathered (which emphasized hydrogen fuel and core conditions) and the Planner’s earlier reasoning that supported D (chemical composition). The misinterpretation led to selecting an incorrect option despite consistent sources indicating the enabling aspect among the choices is the star’s hydrogen-rich composition.
